name: markdown-build-and-acceptance
body: The markdown frontend must be a first-class build artifact staged like the other frontends: a new Rust standalone binary under `src/mdlib`, built by build.rs and staged as `mdfrontend` (the artifact name, consistent with the `pyfrontend`/`csharpfrontend`/`rustfrontend` bare-binary convention). build.rs gains the md block (the APG_BUILD_FRONTENDS allowlist entry, the staged artifact under target/<profile>/frontends, the APG_FRONTEND_MD path, and the APG_LANGUAGES entry) and the runtime frontend lookup resolves it. This is planned code — it does not exist yet and carries no implemented-by (see solution.component.markdown-frontend). Acceptance: a markdown fixture (one document with nested headings, including two identical headings) scans cleanly on a scratch /tmp repo per no-real-project-test; the emitted module/file/section nodes and the heading containment (contains) edges match the exactness rule; a `.mdx` file produces no markdown node. AC: the fixtures scan and the asserted node/edge shapes hold.
